response.query: Which IRT models (Rasch vs GRM) and DIF detection methods are recommended to refine items and ensure fair functioning across demographic and clinical subgroups?
response.answer: For refining items and ensuring fair functioning across subgroups, the Graded Response Model (GRM) and DIF detection methods like SIBTEST are recommended. GRM provides more precise item-level analysis than the Rasch model.
